public_requirements: A worker's launch settings may include max_silent_ms, a positive integer number of milliseconds, which the agent provider uses instead of its own bound for that worker.
A worker without max_silent_ms keeps the provider's bound, even when another worker in its stage sets one.
A max_silent_ms that is not a positive integer makes the configuration malformed; harness and model stay required.
An unset max_silent_ms adds no key to parsed configurations or effect instructions.
